scope: Public asset-index USD/BTC reference values for signed Spot/Futures balance snapshots, wallet-only aggregation, strict Spot low-balance filtering; no full cross-product Portfolio total or financial transfer.
native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, APK install, native price lifecycle/layout or live private account validation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux lacks macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.

acceptance_evidence.existing_behavior_regression: Full suite including Spot/Futures account reads, wallet isolation, orders, notifications, recovery and charts.

boundaries: Anonymous website index endpoint identified in PRD; stable developer compatibility guarantee not asserted.
No stablecoin peg, perpetual mark substitution or unknown balances treated as zero.
Wallet USD subtotal excludes UPL, other accounts/products, collateral discounts and costs. It is not complete Portfolio Total Value.
BTC display division is rounded; exact cross multiplication determines Spot threshold. Unknown/stale quotes and stale account snapshots retain assets.
30s poll, 60s receipt age, 90s quote age and 30s future skew are client policies, not exchange guarantees.
Only public prices refresh automatically. Private snapshots still require explicit current-wallet signing.
Same-EOA authorization acceptance, subaccounts, actual deposit/withdrawal/transfers and full Portfolio scope remain incomplete. BAPI historical statistics and TWAP are skipped at user request.
Transfer documents do not define original clientTranId result lookup or its association with server tranId; no transfer submission was implemented or sent.
build_notes: Passed with existing future KGP compatibility warning from third-party native plugins.
